title: Kissed Crispy Norwegian Epoisses Fritters
description: A citrusy and crispy Norwegian dish featuring Epoisses cheese, perfect for a crowd, and served in a bamboo tray. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is a delightful twist on traditional fritters.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, orange zest, and orange juice until well combined.
Add the crumbled Epoisses cheese to the egg mixture and stir until the cheese is fully incorporated.
Add the dry ingredients to the cheese mixture and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
When ready to fry, heat the melted butter in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot butter, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Roll the fritters in panko breadcrumbs to coat and serve hot in a bamboo tray.
